policy.purpose: Deterministically extract and normalize eligible D1-DATA-RAW-001 artifacts into derived candidate documents without creating an accepted training corpus.

outputPolicy.separatorUsage: Not emitted inside individual document files. It is frozen for any later separately authorized deterministic aggregate stream.

normalization.inputDecode: strict UTF-8; reject on decode error
normalization.lineEndings: Convert CRLF and CR to LF
whitespace: remove trailing ASCII space and tab from every line
preserve leading whitespace and interior horizontal whitespace
collapse runs of more than two blank lines to exactly two blank lines
remove leading and trailing blank/whitespace-only lines
normalization.finalNewline: exactly one LF for every accepted derived document
normalization.headings: preserve verbatim subject to Unicode/line/whitespace normalization
normalization.navigationFragments: no heuristic deletion in D1-NORM-001; preserve source content unless an entire document fails useful-text rules
normalization.sourceMetadata: store lineage in manifest, not injected into document text
normalization.urls: preserve URLs already present in Python text; Gesetze link retained in manifest only and not injected into title text
normalization.codeExamples: preserve code and indentation; no syntax transformation
normalization.tables: preserve source textual representation and spacing except trailing whitespace/blank-line rules
normalization.markup: Python archive is already plain text and is not re-parsed as markup; for Gesetze parse XML structurally and emit only normalized title text
normalization.binaryResidue: reject if decoded content contains U+0000

stableIdentity.gesetzeOriginalIdentity: zero-based XML item ordinal + NUL + exact link string
stableIdentity.derivedDocumentSha256: SHA-256 of final normalized UTF-8 document bytes

python.method: Python zipfile central-directory order replaced by lexicographic member-path order; directories skipped; .txt members decoded strict UTF-8; no filesystem extraction of raw members

gesetze.method: ElementTree parse without network/DTD resolution; iterate item elements in source order; require one nonblank title and one nonblank link; normalize title as document text; link retained only as lineage metadata

perDocumentValidation.exactDuplicateMeasurement: Group equal derived-document SHA-256 values within each source; measure and retain records without deletion.
